chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from one of our companions, who said:

Al-Rida (peace be upon him) would deliver the marriage sermon: 'All praise is to Allah, to glorify His power, and there is no god except Allah, in humility to His majesty, and blessings be upon Muhammad and his progeny,' and upon mentioning Him,
Indeed, Allah created from water a human being, so He made for him relationships of lineage and marriage
up to the end of the Verse.
ai.seo_question: What is the traditional content of the Shia marriage sermon according to Imam Al-Rida?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) structured the marriage sermon with profound theological symbolism, linking the physical act of praise to spiritual submission and invoking blessings upon the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt to emphasize their centrality in the covenant. By reciting Surah Al-Furqan 25:54, he grounded the institution of marriage in divine creation, highlighting how kinship (nasab) and affinity (sihr) serve as enduring signs of Allah's mercy and order within the family structure.
